utility.notes: Orinda is a well-documented Contra Costa County city within PG&E's core Northern California service territory.

generation_supplier.notes: Orinda is not listed among MCE's 16 current Contra Costa County member communities (MCE's own service-area page). No CCA was found serving Orinda this session.

permit_authority.notes: The City of Orinda's own Building Permits page directly confirms Orinda does not have its own building department and contracts with Contra Costa County for building services; Orinda's Planning Department handles zoning review but not permit issuance.

value.name: California SGIP - current category and budget check required
value.description: New applications and waitlist applications for ratepayer-funded SGIP budgets closed on December 30, 2025. New AB 209 applications have a June 30, 2028 deadline. The 2026 SGIP rate table publishes $3.10/W for solar and $1.10/Wh for storage in applicable Residential Solar and Storage Equity categories. Household eligibility and live budget availability vary by category and program administrator; check the official Program Metrics tracker before relying on an incentive.
value.eligibility: Eligibility varies by 2026 SGIP budget category, program administrator, property, income/pathway, project rules, and live funding availability.

battery_programs.notes: SGIP program data refreshed on 2026-08-26 from the official 2026 Handbook and live Program Metrics. Earlier locality records contained 2025 opening/availability language. This record does not assert household eligibility, reservation availability, or a guaranteed incentive; current category and program-administrator status must be checked before reliance.

value: Call 925-646-4108 to schedule inspection with the automated phone system, and schedule the '120 Building-Final' inspection
Same-day inspections via the automated phone system are accepted until 5:30 AM Monday-Friday; requests left on voicemail will not be scheduled
Inspections can also be scheduled online by searching for the permit number
inspection_steps.notes: Contra Costa County's own SolarAPP+ page explicitly lists Orinda among the jurisdictions covered by this process (Unincorporated County, Clayton, Hercules, Lafayette, Orinda, and the Town of Moraga).

value.notes: Contra Costa County's own SolarAPP+ page (which explicitly covers Orinda) states 'The permit will be auto-issued and emailed to you in a few minutes' after submitting the SolarAPP+-approved application and paying fees, and that eligible projects use 'the automated SolarAPP+ portal for instant permitting.'

value.program_or_pathway: Contra Costa County building permit (Orinda contracts building services to the County)
other_conditions: Planning Department review is not required for flush, roof-mounted solar on residential properties, regardless of system size
A building permit is mandatory for any solar installation
Additional clearances may be required from the Sanitary District/Environmental Health (for septic systems) or the Moraga-Orinda Fire District

permit_fees.notes: The page directs applicants to Contra Costa County's Building Department for pricing; a specific dollar figure was not stated on the city's own page.
